capabilities: move the active tab left or right
move tabs across tab groups at the edges
reorder tabs via commands with default Mod+Shift+PageUp/PageDown hotkeys
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to move the active tab left or right in the tab strip.
summary: Command-based tab mover that reorders the active tab left or right within and across tab groups.
